```sql
WITH oi AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(product_price) AS revenue
  FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items"
  WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
  SUM(oi.revenue) - SUM(o.order_cost) AS gross_profit_2025,
  (SUM(oi.revenue) - SUM(o.order_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.revenue), 0) AS gross_margin_pct_2025
FROM oi
JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders" o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id;
```
